decision.reason: DEP-M9 AIP-9 and W7-04 are not GREEN; current MediaReference is an in-memory legacy bridge with mock storage and cannot be treated as a tenant-safe media production authority

verifiedFoundations: AIP-7 exact model route provider policy price and readiness contracts exist as code-green foundations
AipProviderUsageBridge requires an exact selected provider and provider usage receipts before forwarding to canonical Usage authority
legacy MediaReference can represent local or mock-S3 paths and issue demonstration URLs
AIP-9 plan explicitly requires license provenance hash timeouts corrupted-output handling and no direct publish in this wave
focused generic provider usage and legacy media-reference tests are GREEN
blockers: DEP-M9 reports zero real Provider Route and Eval readiness; AIP-9 media and capacity are not GREEN
W7-04 media Stage executor fenced lease checkpoint takeover and provider reconcile are not GREEN
planned aip_media_jobs aip_avatar_sessions aip_content_pipeline and media workbench files are absent
speech.synthesize video.compose and live.orchestrate have no exact operational Provider binding for org-org/dev-project
no media adapter contract closes submit status cancel timeout webhook reconcile immutable provider receipt and idempotency
legacy MediaReference is process-memory state without tenant identity PostgreSQL RLS restart durability or canonical receipts
legacy MediaReference permits destructive delete and mutable thumbnails instead of append-only revision and revocation impact
legacy S3 adapter is a mock whose exists always succeeds and local signed URL exposes a file URI; neither is production evidence
signed URL issuance is not bound to principal purpose marking license object hash or bounded policy and has no access receipt
no input quarantine content-type sniff hash malware archive-bomb or decompression-limit gate exists
no prompt-injection isolation for OCR captions metadata EXIF subtitles scripts or embedded documents exists
no exact license provenance portrait trademark consent or product-claim authorization decision is enforced before Provider egress
no outbound egress allowlist redaction secret stripping or per-provider data-retention decision is bound to the attempt
legacy ProviderSecurity defaults to audit prompt and response and is not a safe proof that PII secrets or media payloads are excluded
no output malware policy watermark provenance schema media-decode duration dimension or corruption gate exists before Artifact acceptance
no org-org positive adapter path or dev-org isolation canary exists and no real Provider call is authorized

targetBoundary.adapter: one reviewed media adapter interface covers acquire generate TTS render and optional live session operations without bypassing canonical Task lease
targetBoundary.resolution: every attempt freezes exact Capability Binding Model Route Provider Policy Price License and Eval refs and rechecks readiness before egress
targetBoundary.input: tenant-scoped immutable source refs pass quarantine hash malware license consent marking and prompt-injection isolation before short-lived purpose-bound fetch
targetBoundary.provider: stable request fingerprint submit receipt polling webhook reconcile cancel and timeout prevent blind retry after ambiguous side effects
targetBoundary.output: provider result stays quarantined until hash decode schema malware license provenance watermark and policy gates produce immutable evidence
targetBoundary.secrets: secret refs resolve only inside the adapter and never enter Artifact metadata prompt logs command arguments receipts or shared memory
targetBoundary.authority: Artifacts Usage and Receipts remain canonical AIP authorities; Workshop stores only projections and exact refs

tests.meaning: three generic provider-usage and twenty-two legacy media-reference tests are stable; they do not prove production media adapters tenant safety or malicious-asset defenses

next: align W7-07 contracts and checklist through two review rounds, retain the item unchecked, then preflight W7-08
safety: no real provider call or signed production URL
